empty.title: No training runs yet
empty.body: Train a model on your annotated images. First assign images to the Train and Valid splits, then start a run.

notFound.title: Run not found
notFound.body: This run does not exist in this project or was removed.

preparing.title: Preparing the dataset…
preparing.body: Linking images and writing labels. Large datasets can take a few minutes.

queued.title: In queue: position {{position}}
queued.body: The run starts automatically when the worker is free. You can close this page.

running.startingHint: The first use of an official model downloads its weights.
running.finalValidationHint: Checking the best model on the validation images. The model is registered right after.
running.closeHint: You can close this page. Training continues in the background.

completed.title: Training complete
completed.earlyStop: Training stopped early at epoch {{epoch}} of {{epochs}} because the metrics stopped improving.

failed.title: Training failed
failed.noMessage: The training process stopped without an error message. Check the log below.

interrupted.title: Run interrupted
interrupted.body: The service was restarted while this run was training.
interrupted.action: Start a new run to train again.

cancelled.title: Run cancelled
cancelled.body: This run was cancelled before it finished.

cancelling.title: Cancelling…
cancelling.body: Stopping the training process. This takes a few seconds.

cancel.title: Cancel training
cancel.body: Training will stop at epoch {{epoch}}. You can resume it from the last checkpoint.
cancel.note: The epoch in progress is not saved.

remove.title: Remove from queue
remove.body: Run "{{name}}" will be removed from the queue and its prepared dataset will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
remove.done: Run "{{name}}" was removed from the queue.

loss.title: Loss
loss.caption: Sum of all loss components. Hover for the breakdown.

charts.waiting: Charts appear after the first epoch finishes.

stream.unavailable: Live updates are unavailable. Charts show data up to the last update.

model.version: Trained with Ultralytics {{version}}. Use the same or a newer version to load it.

name.label: Run name
name.hint: Also the name of the resulting model.

base.label: Base model
base.classesDiffer: This model's classes differ from this project's classes. Training adapts it to this project's classes, but what it learned about its own classes may be lost.

epochs.label: Epochs
epochs.hint: How many passes over the training images. 100 is the Ultralytics default.

imgsz.label: Image size
imgsz.hint: Images are resized to this many pixels on the longer side. Must be a multiple of 32.

batch.label: Batch size
batch.hint: Auto picks the largest batch that fits the GPU, and uses 16 on CPU.

device.label: Device
device.noGpu: No GPU was detected, so training runs on the CPU.
device.cpuHint: Training on a CPU is slow. For a first try, use a small model, few epochs and a small image size.

worker.stale: The training worker is not responding. The run will wait in the queue until it starts.

name.tooLong: Name must be at most 100 characters.

validation.epochs: Epochs must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
validation.imgsz: Image size must be a multiple of 32, from 32 to 2048.
validation.batch: Batch size must be a whole number from 1 to 512.

blocker.noClasses: This project has no classes. Add at least one class first.
blocker.trainEmpty: No annotated images are assigned to Train. Assign images to it or split the dataset automatically.
blocker.validEmpty: No annotated images are assigned to Valid. Assign images to it or split the dataset automatically.

warning.unannotated: Unannotated images that will not be used: {{count}}.
warning.unassigned: Images without a split that will not be used: {{count}}.
warning.classesMissingTrain: No examples in Train for these classes: {{names}}.
warning.classesMissingValid: No examples in Valid for these classes: {{names}}.

summary.title: Dataset
summary.manualHint: Or assign images by hand on the <pagelink>Images page</pagelink>.

finalResults.title: Final results (best.pt)
finalResults.caption: Final validation of the best checkpoint on the validation images.

out_of_memory.title: Out of memory
out_of_memory.hint: The GPU or the system ran out of memory. Start a new run with a smaller batch size or image size, or pick a smaller model.

disk_full.title: Disk is full
disk_full.hint: There is no free space left for training files. Free up disk space in the data folder (DATA_DIR), then resume this run or start a new one.

invalid_dataset.title: Invalid dataset
invalid_dataset.hint: Training could not read the dataset. Check that the images and annotations are valid, then start a new run.

weights_download.title: Could not download model weights
weights_download.hint: Official model weights are downloaded on first use. Check the worker's internet connection or place the weights file in DATA_DIR/weights/, then start a new run.

process_killed.title: Training process was killed
process_killed.hint: The system stopped the training process, most often because it ran out of memory. Give Docker more memory or use a smaller batch or image size, then resume or start a new run.

not_resumable.title: Cannot resume
not_resumable.hint: The saved checkpoint is missing, damaged, or training had already finished. Start a new run instead.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.hint: Open the log below for details. If it keeps happening, start a new run.
